children: China's mine-origin blister copper smelting capacity has nearly hit a ceiling in 2026, Chen Xuesen, vice president at the state-backed China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association told Reuters on the sidelines of an event by the International Copper Association on Tuesday.
Blister copper is a product that will be processed further into refined copper used in construction, manufacturing and electrification.
